description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set update loop runs in two passes: pass 1 handles role-null (vacating) patches, pass 2 handles role-claiming patches. This correctly handles the common IMAP role-swap pattern (detach inbox, attach to new mailbox in one request) regardless of map iteration order — which is unspecified for serde_json::Map. A contributor might suggest a single pass; this should be defended on the grounds that map iteration order is not guaranteed and a single pass would make role-swap order-dependent, which would be a user-visible correctness bug.
title: Two-pass update loop for Mailbox role vacate/claim is correct
